reference_sql:
WITH mrr AS (
  -- one row per subscription, its MRR on 31 December 2025
  SELECT subscription_id, SUM(mrr_delta_local) AS mrr_local
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY subscription_id
)
SELECT a.segment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.currency = 'EUR' THEN m.mrr_local ELSE 0 END) AS mrr_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.currency = 'GBP' THEN m.mrr_local ELSE 0 END) AS mrr_gbp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.currency = 'CHF' THEN m.mrr_local ELSE 0 END) AS mrr_chf
FROM mrr m
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = m.subscription_id
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
GROUP BY a.segment

JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
GROUP BY a.segment

solver.query:
SELECT a.segment,
  COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) FILTER (WHERE s.currency = 'EUR'), 0) AS mrr_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) FILTER (WHERE s.currency = 'GBP'), 0) AS mrr_gbp,
  COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) FILTER (WHERE s.currency = 'CHF'), 0) AS mrr_chf
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
LEFT JOIN subscription_events e ON e.subscription_id = s.subscription_id AND e.event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY a.segment
